title: Greatness is Made, Not Born: Preparing in the Dungeon of Lockdown
summary: President Hughes shares two stories—the literary tale of Edmond Dantès from 'The Count of Monte Cristo' and a fable about a jailed counselor lifting growing pigs—to illustrate how greatness is forged through daily discipline and practice rather than innate luck. He challenges the missionaries to use their extensive study time during the quarantine lockdown wisely, preparing themselves for a meaningful future.
